jobs.title: Full Streaming Data Sync
jobs.description: Comprehensive sync of watch history, watchlists, and recommendations from all streaming services
jobs.prompt: Run sync_all_streaming_data for user chad with include_recommendations=true. Report the total items synced from each service and any errors.

jobs.title: Watch History Poll
jobs.description: Sync Continue Watching data from all streaming services every 6 hours
jobs.prompt: Run poll_watch_history for user chad. Report how many items were found and saved for each service.

jobs.title: Watchlists Poll
jobs.description: Sync My List / Watchlist items from all streaming services
jobs.prompt: Run poll_watchlists for user chad. Report how many watchlist items were found for each service.

jobs.title: Recommendations Poll
jobs.description: Sync personalized recommendations from all streaming services
jobs.prompt: Run poll_recommendations for user chad. Report how many recommendations were found for each service.

jobs.title: Credential Health Check
jobs.description: Verify that all streaming service credentials are still valid and report any that need re-authentication
jobs.prompt: Run check_credential_status and report which streaming services have valid credentials and which need re-authentication.

jobs.title: TV Listings Refresh
jobs.description: Trigger refresh of TV guide listings data to ensure cache is current
jobs.prompt: Call get_tv_listings_now with sports_only=false to refresh TV listings data.

metadata.description: Scheduled jobs for streaming data synchronization and maintenance
notes: All polling tools automatically save data to the database - no additional steps needed
Full sync can take 15-20 minutes as it scrapes all services with browser automation
Recommendations polling is slow due to browser scraping - run during off-peak hours
Watch history is most dynamic and should be polled frequently (every 6 hours)
TV listings refresh is lightweight and can run more frequently
